notes.title: Next fest ready! Earthcrawler Boss update.
notes.content:
Release for the Next Fest!

This has the new boss the Earthcrawler, as well as hovering enhanced from the target focus view will show the enhancement effects.  Cleaned up texts as well.

notes.title: Pre-Next Fest update! Biome Boons and general improvements!
notes.content:
This update has new Biome Boons (modifiers) that add traps you can path enemies into for bonus effects! 
It also has bug fixes, UI improvements and new graphics, new settings menu for keybindings, and improved balance.  
A couple places have better feedback when buttons are clicked as well.

notes.title: Short update user Feedback improvement.
notes.content: The feedback no longer requires / uses Unity Analytics.  It is not independent and easier for me to analyze and players to submit!

notes.title: Biomes Update Completed!
notes.content:
Hello,

In this update I finished the Biomes update.  This includes the following :
[olist]
[*]Special music in each zone.
[*] Re-visits should be more unique
[*] Some visual updates
[*] Reliability matters more
[*] Unique traps in each Biome.
[/olist]

It took a while to do and I hope it was worth it!  I intend to enter the Steam Next Fest soon and will be focusing on polishing the game in the coming month.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Update bugs update, precursor to the map update, biome updates.
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Ally and Enemy Base[/b][/h2]
Models are updated for each biome.
In addition next enemy wave type has an image shown over enemy base.

[b] Each biome now has a distinct soundtrack.[/b]

[h2][b]Experimental effects in Ice biome[/b][/h2]
Minor level modifications.
Additionally, there are effects that slow enemies who path into it slowing them down.  Testing how they feel.

[b]New models for a couple towers that repeated.[/b]

notes.title: Turret Room Update - Easier on the eyes.
notes.content:
I received feedback that the turret room was too much to read and overwhelming.  I synced the information into a consistent format, culled less useful information (like secondary target range) and cleaned up the text so things like 
'Tower Damage' -> 'Damage'

Overall I think about 30% less text, and tags at the bottom for keywords which will help explain if needed.

I hope it feels more clean and easier to parse!

Thanks.

notes.title: Hotfix Plasma Crystal range.
notes.content:
Quick hotfix, Plasma crystal augment range upgrade wasnt working.  

Also, changed duplicate face in new character select to ?.

notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.content:
Updated tutorial images and text.

roughly 35% -50% less text in popups.  
Re-worded some things, overall should be less of a slog.

notes.title: Events, Art, and Balance.
notes.content:
[b]Events [/b]
New events are available, they have a chance to spawn attached to a mission.  You will see an icon when picking a mission if it has it.
These new events make the map harder and award bonus gold. 
The three events to far are :
Monster Zoo  - random spawns like before.
Monster Mutations - spawn +1 Enhanced per wave.
Monster Swarm - Every generic is 1 type and it spawn +2 per wave. 
[b]
New Art[/b]
Tinker Room has background art now.
Bestiary now has sketches for each enemy.
The Globadier has a new Model.

[b]Balance Update[/b]
Gold Economy improved.  More gold per level.
No Ice enhanced enemies in biome 1, unless the event is chosen to add enhanced.
Sniper tower is nurfed in range 2.25 -> 1.85, and Dmg from 4.15 -> 4.0
Missile Tower has received many small adjustments to buff it, most notable attack speed 4.0 -> 3.0

[b]Misc[/b]
Transition sound when screen changing.

notes.title: Tower Identity for Sniper and Industrial Ice.
notes.content:
This patch is focused on better tower identity on strengths and weaknesses for the Sniper (rifled) tower as well as the Industrial (ice) tower.   Industrial just didnt feel good to use so it also has just a small buff as well.

minor - 
The images when selecting a new map is bigger.

Major -
Ice tower Industrial Base.
Base slow is increased from 5% -> 10%.
Base slime removal time Improved from 25s -> 20s
Blade (augments) have increased pros and cons, with the AOE increasing from 25% -> 30% and the cons respectively increased.
Industrial blades effect slime removal time instead of slow amount now at a rate of +- 7 seconds.
the increase in slow is reduced for industrial from 5% -> 3%

Rifled Tower Sniper Augment
Attack Speed Improved from 5.5/s  -> 4.5/s 
Damage Reduced from 5.0x -> 4.2x
Range increased from 2.0x -> 2.25x
Cant target range increased from .33% -> .40%
*New* Sniper now has instant bullet shots, which hit the target selected instead of traveling projectile.
*new* plume of smoke on sniper firing.

Fixes -
The Sniper tower Cant Target range UI is now displayed properly.

notes.title: Second update to Playtest!
notes.content:
2nd update, has :
Added more resolutions.
If you try to leave base and have less towers setup than known displays a prompt (know 3 towers and only have 1 setup for example)
Changed Colors of artifacts in descriptions to emphasize hovering to read effects.
Moved Soldier to first slot in new characters as his helps the most for new players.
Increased Frost tower mastery.

Bugfixes :
Fixed mastery so that if it doesnt change the percent will display correctly.

New models:
Healer.
Burrower.

notes.title: First patch based on feedback!
notes.content:
---- new waves experiment --- waves will be comprised mostly of 1 single type with the exception of SPECIALS (slimer and healer) which can still spawn during any wave.
With it, next wave enemy type is displayed at the bottom left of the screen.
game difficulty is a little easier at the start, about 15% lower health on all enemies, ramping back up to(mostly normal) in biome 3.
[strike]Continue button will grey out if no run is currently in progress.  [/strike]
It will not grey out until next patch, so it does not ruin any runs currently.
Additionally, Continue will show the level you are on.
The hack button for learning new towers will now grey out when selected.
The micro rockets for missile archetype has the floating s for rocket count upgrade removed.

New art for the following enemies:
Slimer,
Swarmer,
Roller,
The bestiary has been updated accordingly
